title: Really impressive habit app
body:
Very functional, very artistic app, I hope the developer gets more support and reviews.. I'll surely be buying the pro version after I get to use this for couple more days.. I really love the user interface.. 
one request: please let us "check as done" on the "habits tab" and not just on the "todays tab" thnx much.. also it would be nice if we can change the sound when we press "done" thnx much Really great work.. God bless...
